scope.population: Living human city residents before the thirty-year termination threshold
scope.exclusions: The film’s AI ruler and different novel institutions are excluded; terminated residents are not leisure citizens.

after.description:
The television City of Domes is secretly governed by older humans while enforcing a thirty-year rule on ordinary residents. Its high-capacity enclosed environment is a plausible technical support order, but bodily security is sharply conditional. The guarantee best guess allows a substantial internal floor without calling forced termination a dependable lifetime guarantee. Household coverage is estimated rather than copied wholesale from the film.

 Concentrated human council authority receives control near the elite reference point. The film’s central-machine sovereignty is not imported into this continuity simply because both cities use advanced systems. The high nonworking scenario permits extensive routine substitution while counting assigned security, administration, maintenance, care and useful creation. Short lives and deaths are not converted into a leisure percentage. The television period and controller remain explicit, preventing the original novel, film and series from being merged into one contradictory society or counted again merely for identical visual scenery.

guarantees.basis: Internal support is plausible but the termination rule sharply limits lifetime security.

control.basis: Older human council members govern this television continuity.

nonworking.basis: Substantial substitution may coexist with assigned roles and care; deaths are excluded.

after.description:
Gary serves five years repairing satellites with machine companions aboard Galaxy One. The discovery lead’s Infinity label is corrected to the supported ship and period. Automated bodily support and robotic assistance coexist with an actual imposed human role. The guarantee best guess allows a partial institutional floor, qualified by incarceration and dependence on the ship’s rules. The repair duty is not called useless make-work without evidence.

 Practical ship AI authority receives negative control weight alongside the human legal framework imposing the sentence. Formal human ownership does not erase day-to-day machine discretion, but the ship is not assumed to be an independent worldwide AI government. The central nonworking value is zero for the single active human because recurring satellite repair is work. Alternatives are binary rather than fractions of the five years. Robot count, isolation and time resting do not create additional leisure citizens. This narrow zero variant covers the continuing sentence rather than later crews or ships.

scope.exclusions: Children’s actual work counts; private schooling and play are not automatically jobs and alternate endings are separate.

after.description:
Colonists and children perform farming, compost work, repair, care, construction and research alongside advanced technology. The material system is therefore an engineered frontier community retaining substantial useful contribution. The guarantee best guess allows a partial shared floor, qualified by survival pressures and local duties. Technical capacity and communal life do not themselves prove that every necessity arrives automatically or that all work is already dispensable.

 Human community institutions receive positive control weight, with leadership and infrastructure dependence inside the interval. A technological colony is not automatically an autonomous AI government. The low nonworking scenario counts the stated productive and caring roles, including work actually done by children. Private learning and play are not assumed useful labor merely because they consume time. Farm output and the protagonist’s schedule are not a population employment census. This zero variant selects the functioning colony rather than combining every possible ending or assigning one universal rights system to the whole planet.

after.description:
Tao citizens inhabit historical recreations with real generations, variable local rule and robot labor where appropriate. They are residents rather than merely temporary avatars in an attraction. The guarantee best guess allows a strong underlying technical floor, qualified by local restrictions and staged conflict. A historical appearance does not prove that residents depend on wholly preindustrial production, while recreating a society does not itself guarantee equal access everywhere.

 Human resident and organizing institutions receive positive control weight. Mostly nonsentient robot labor is equipment under that arrangement, not automatically an AI sovereign. The low-to-moderate nonworking scenario counts care, administration, maintenance and performance that provides entertainment to others. Private historical play is not automatically a job, and voluntary useful performance is not automatically leisure. Only active persons enter the proxy population. The point preserves the Tao’s distinct maintained-historical material model rather than merging it with Stardweller basics or the Patent Office’s employed field agents.
